sample_unit: transcripts (100 endocrinology transcripts and 140 modified ACI benchmark cases)

links.outcome: Major hallucinations and factual correctness in AI-generated notes on ACI benchmark, base vs fine-tuned model
links.effect: Major hallucinations fell from 85 to 35 cases after fine-tuning, so the base model hallucinated often and the tuned model still did; factual correctness rose from 2.81 to 3.54 on a 5-point scale.
links.quote: Clinical quality assessments showed marked reduction in major hallucinations (from 85 to 35 cases) and enhanced factual correctness (2.81 to 3.54 on 5-point scale).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a compact LLM on synthetic transcript-to-note pairs to improve note quality
On-device, in-browser deployment of a scribe model to preserve data sovereignty and reduce cost

screen.reason: Evaluates a fine-tuned compact LLM for on-device medical transcription and structured note generation against benchmarks, but does not test organizational deployment practices or guardrails.
